SELECT id, source, target,
CASE WHEN driving_cost_s > 0 THEN length_m ELSE -1.0 END::FLOAT8 AS cost, CASE WHEN driving_reverse_s > 0 THEN length_m ELSE -1.0 END::FLOAT8 AS reverse_cost
CASE WHEN driving_cost_s > 0 THEN driving_cost_s ELSE -1.0 END::FLOAT8 AS cost, CASE WHEN driving_reverse_s > 0 THEN driving_reverse_s ELSE -1.0 END::FLOAT8 AS reverse_cost
CASE WHEN walking_cost_s > 0 THEN length_m ELSE -1.0 END::FLOAT8 AS cost, CASE WHEN walking_reverse_s > 0 THEN length_m ELSE -1.0 END::FLOAT8 AS reverse_cost
CASE WHEN walking_cost_s > 0 THEN walking_cost_s ELSE -1.0 END::FLOAT8 AS cost, CASE WHEN walking_reverse_s > 0 THEN walking_reverse_s ELSE -1.0 END::FLOAT8 AS reverse_cost
FROM public.road_edge WHERE status = 'active'
AND COALESCE(access_car, true) AND driving_cost_s > 0
AND COALESCE(access_walk, true) AND walking_cost_s > 0
mapper.select:
WITH query_point AS ( SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{x}, #{y}), 0) AS geom ), candidate AS ( SELECT edge.id AS edge_id, edge.geom_local, edge.network_version, query.geom AS query_geom FROM public.road_edge edge CROSS JOIN query_point query WHERE edge.status = 'active'
AND COALESCE(edge.access_car, true) AND edge.driving_cost_s > 0
AND COALESCE(edge.access_walk, true) AND edge.walking_cost_s > 0
AND ST_DWithin(edge.geom_local, query.geom, #{maxDistanceLocal}) ORDER BY edge.geom_local <-> query.geom, edge.id LIMIT 1 ), snapped AS ( SELECT edge_id, geom_local, network_version, query_geom, ST_ClosestPoint(geom_local, query_geom) AS snapped_geom FROM candidate ) SELECT edge_id AS edgeId, ST_LineLocatePoint(geom_local, snapped_geom) AS fraction, ST_X(snapped_geom) AS snappedX, ST_Y(snapped_geom) AS snappedY, ST_Distance(query_geom, snapped_geom) AS distanceLocal, network_version AS networkVersion FROM snapped

WITH route_result AS ( SELECT route.*, LEAD(route.node) OVER (ORDER BY route.path_seq) AS next_node FROM pgr_withPoints( $edges$
$edges$, format( $points$ SELECT * FROM (VALUES (1::BIGINT, %L::BIGINT, %L::FLOAT8, 'b'::CHAR(1)), (2::BIGINT, %L::BIGINT, %L::FLOAT8, 'b'::CHAR(1)) ) AS point(pid, edge_id, fraction, side) $points$, #{origin.edgeId}, #{origin.fraction}, #{destination.edgeId}, #{destination.fraction} ), -1::BIGINT, -2::BIGINT, directed => true, driving_side => 'b', details => true ) route ), fractions AS ( SELECT route.path_seq, route.edge, edge.geom_local, edge.network_version, edge.driving_cost_s, edge.driving_reverse_s, edge.walking_cost_s, edge.walking_reverse_s, CASE WHEN route.node = -1 THEN #{origin.fraction} WHEN route.node = -2 THEN #{destination.fraction} WHEN route.node = edge.source THEN 0.0 WHEN route.node = edge.target THEN 1.0 END AS from_fraction, CASE WHEN route.next_node = -1 THEN #{origin.fraction} WHEN route.next_node = -2 THEN #{destination.fraction} WHEN route.next_node = edge.source THEN 0.0 WHEN route.next_node = edge.target THEN 1.0 END AS to_fraction FROM route_result route JOIN public.road_edge edge ON edge.id = route.edge WHERE route.edge >= 0 ), parts AS ( SELECT path_seq, network_version, CASE WHEN from_fraction < to_fraction THEN cut_geom ELSE ST_Reverse(cut_geom) END AS geom,
CASE WHEN from_fraction < to_fraction THEN driving_cost_s ELSE driving_reverse_s END * ABS(to_fraction - from_fraction) AS duration_seconds
CASE WHEN from_fraction < to_fraction THEN walking_cost_s ELSE walking_reverse_s END * ABS(to_fraction - from_fraction) AS duration_seconds
FROM fractions CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ST_LineSubstring( geom_local, LEAST(from_fraction, to_fraction), GREATEST(from_fraction, to_fraction) ) AS cut_geom ) cut WHERE from_fraction IS NOT NULL AND to_fraction IS NOT NULL AND from_fraction <> to_fraction ) SELECT SUM(ST_Length(geom))::FLOAT8 AS distanceLocal, SUM(duration_seconds)::FLOAT8 AS durationSeconds, ST_AsText(ST_MakeLine(geom ORDER BY path_seq)) AS geometryWkt, MAX(network_version) AS networkVersion FROM parts HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

SELECT ABS(cost.start_vid) AS startPid, ABS(cost.end_vid) AS endPid, cost.agg_cost AS aggCost FROM pgr_withPointsCostMatrix( $edges$
$edges$, format( $points$ SELECT pid, edge_id, fraction, side FROM jsonb_to_recordset(%L::JSONB) AS point(pid BIGINT, edge_id BIGINT, fraction FLOAT8, side CHAR(1)) $points$, CAST(#{pointsJson} AS JSONB) ), ARRAY( SELECT -point.pid FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CAST(#{pointsJson} AS JSONB)) AS point(pid BIGINT) ORDER BY point.pid )::BIGINT[], directed => true, driving_side => 'b' ) cost ORDER BY startPid, endPid
